A simple MIDI example

The following code shows a MIDI streaming example using Remi.

// remiTest.cpp - Realtime MIDI test, ver. 1.00
//

#include "../lib/include/pandora.h"
#include "../lib/include/Remi.h"
#include <stdexcept>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;
Remi r;

#if defined (USE_PORTMIDI)
    void callback (PtTimestamp timestamp, void *userData) {
        PmError result;
        PmEvent buffer;
        
        if (!r.isRunning ())
            return;
            
        do {
            result = (PmError) r.poll ();
            if (result) {
                long status, data1, data2;
                if (r.read (&buffer, 1) > 0){ 
                    status = Pm_MessageStatus (buffer.message);
                    data1 = Pm_MessageData1 (buffer.message);
                    data2 = Pm_MessageData2 (buffer.message);
                  
                    cout << status << " " << data1 << " " << data2 << "\r";
                    r.write (&buffer, 1);
                }               
            }
        } while (result);
    }
#endif

int main (int argc, char* argv[]) {
    try {
        cout << "[Realtime MIDI test, ver. 1.00]" << endl << endl 
             << "Written by Carmine E. Cella, 2005" << endl
             << "based on the Pandora Audio Framework" << endl
             << "web: www.cryptosound.org" << endl << endl;
                    
        vector <int> v = r.outputDevices ();
        
        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < v.size (); i++) {
            cout << v[i] << endl << r.deviceInfo(v[i]) << endl; 
        }
        cout << "select: ";
        int a = 0;
        cin >> a;

        vector <int> v1 = r.inputDevices ();
        
        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < v1.size (); i++) {
            cout << v1[i] << endl << r.deviceInfo(v1[i]) << endl; 
        }
        cout << "select: ";
        int b = 0;
        cin >> b;       
        
        r.outputDevice (a); 
        r.inputDevice (b);
        
        cout << "press RETURN to close..." << endl;
        r.start (callback);
        getchar ();
        getchar ();
        r.stop ();
    }
    catch (runtime_error& e) {
        cout << "Runtime error: " << e.what () << endl;
        getchar ();
    }
    catch (exception& e) {
        cout << "Generic exception: " << e.what () << endl;
        getchar ();
    }
    catch (...) {
        cout << "Fatal error: unknown exception" << endl;
        getchar ();
    }
    return 0;
}

// EOF
